facts.fact: Yogurt là phần mềm mã nguồn mở hoàn toàn miễn phí phát hành theo giấy phép MIT và không yêu cầu đăng ký tài khoản.
facts.quote: Yogurt is free and open source under the MIT license. No account is needed.

facts.fact: Yogurt không dùng bot tham gia phòng họp mà trực tiếp ghi âm từ micro và luồng âm thanh phát ra trên máy tính.
facts.quote: Yogurt records your calls without adding a bot to the meeting.

facts.fact: Yogurt hỗ trợ macOS 14.4+ (Apple Silicon), Windows 10 2004+ (x64) và Linux Ubuntu 22.04+ (bản AppImage) với yêu cầu RAM tối thiểu 8 GB.
facts.quote: macOS 14.4+ (Apple Silicon) · Windows 10 2004+ (x64) · Ubuntu 22.04+ or similar (x64 AppImage) · 8 GB memory

facts.fact: Dữ liệu âm thanh, văn bản bóc băng và bản tóm tắt được xử lý và lưu trữ cục bộ, không bị tải lên máy chủ ngoài.
facts.quote: The AI runs on your computer, so your recordings, transcripts, and notes are never uploaded.

facts.fact: Tính năng bóc băng sử dụng Whisper thông qua whisper.cpp (mô hình large-v3-turbo hoặc nhỏ hơn tùy cấu hình máy) kết hợp Apple SpeechAnalyzer trên macOS hỗ trợ.
facts.quote: Transcription uses Whisper through whisper.cpp, with large-v3-turbo or a smaller model depending on your computer.

facts.fact: Tính năng tóm tắt và hỏi đáp cuộc họp sử dụng mô hình mã nguồn mở cục bộ thuộc họ Gemma 4, gpt-oss hoặc Qwen3 thông qua llama.cpp.
facts.quote: Summaries and answers use a local open-weight model from the Gemma 4, gpt-oss or Qwen3 families, chosen for your hardware and run through llama.cpp.

facts.fact: Yogurt tải mô hình ghi chép ban đầu khoảng 5 GB và có thể tải thêm mô hình lớn hơn từ 14 GB trở lên tùy thuộc vào phần cứng máy.
facts.quote: Yogurt downloads a smaller notes model first, about 5 GB, then the best one your computer can run well, which can be 14 GB or more.

facts.fact: Chế độ Multi-language cho phép bóc băng nhận diện 99 ngôn ngữ, dù mặc định ban đầu là chỉ tiếng Anh.
facts.quote: Pick **Multi-language** in **Settings → Language → Spoken language** to transcribe 99 languages.

facts.fact: Khả năng nhận diện tên người phát biểu trên Zoom, Microsoft Teams và Google Meet hiện chỉ hỗ trợ riêng trên hệ điều hành macOS.
facts.quote: Yogurt names speakers from Zoom, Teams and Meet on Mac only.

facts.fact: Tính năng đồng bộ lịch họp và nhắc nhở cuộc gọi hiện chỉ hoạt động trên macOS bằng cách đọc lịch có sẵn trên hệ thống.
facts.quote: Calendar and speaker names from calls are Mac only for now.

facts.fact: Yogurt tích hợp máy chủ MCP (Model Context Protocol) cục bộ ở chế độ chỉ đọc để kết nối với các ứng dụng trợ lý AI khác.
facts.quote: In **Settings → AI apps**, turn on access, copy the helper command, and add it as a local MCP server in your assistant app.

facts.fact: Trên Linux, Yogurt lưu trữ dữ liệu cuộc họp, cấu hình và mô hình tại thư mục ~/.config/Yogurt hoặc $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Yogurt.
Ứng dụng máy trạm Yogurt được đóng gói bằng Electron và hoàn toàn không bắt buộc đăng nhập tài khoản.
facts.quote: The app uses Electron and needs no account.

facts.fact: Meetily là một giải pháp thay thế mã nguồn mở viết bằng Rust (Tauri) và Next.js, hỗ trợ cả Whisper và mô hình Parakeet của NVIDIA.
facts.quote: Meetily is a single, self-contained application built with [Tauri](https://tauri.app/). It uses a Rust-based backend to handle all the core logic

facts.fact: Meetily hỗ trợ tóm tắt linh hoạt qua Ollama chạy local hoặc BYOK thông qua Claude, Groq, OpenRouter và các endpoint tương thích OpenAI.
facts.quote: Choose from Ollama (local), Claude, Groq, OpenRouter, or use your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

facts.fact: Bản miễn phí của Meetily bị giới hạn tính năng nhận diện người nói và xuất file nâng cao; gói Pro có giá 10 USD/người dùng/tháng trả theo năm.
facts.quote: Pro adds speaker identification (who said what), custom summary templates, PDF/DOCX export, and MCP, CLI and webhook integrations.

caveats: Yogurt là ứng dụng desktop (Electron) bắt buộc chạy trên máy có phần cứng đồ họa và thiết bị âm thanh (Microphone/System audio); nguồn tài liệu không cung cấp cơ chế chạy dạng daemon headless trên VPS Linux tiêu chuẩn.
Khả năng nhận diện người nói (speaker diarization/names) và đọc lịch họp chỉ hỗ trợ duy nhất trên macOS, chưa hỗ trợ Windows và Linux.
Yêu cầu dung lượng bộ nhớ lớn: Dung lượng mô hình tải về tối thiểu 5 GB và có thể vượt quá 14 GB, đòi hỏi cấu hình máy có ít nhất 8 GB RAM.
Mặc định ứng dụng chỉ nhận diện tiếng Anh; người dùng phải tự vào Settings đổi sang chế độ Multi-language để nhận diện 99 ngôn ngữ khác.
Bảo mật MCP: Máy chủ MCP cục bộ không có token phân quyền riêng cho từng ứng dụng, bất kỳ phần mềm nào chạy dưới cùng tài khoản người dùng đều có thể đọc toàn bộ ghi chép khi MCP được bật.
Trên Windows, ứng dụng sẽ hiện cảnh báo bảo mật SmartScreen do chưa có chứng chỉ số của Microsoft.
gaps: Yogurt có cách nào chạy headless trên VPS Linux (không cần màn hình/card âm thanh vật lý) để nhận file ghi âm qua API/Webhook rồi tự động tóm tắt hay không?
Chất lượng nhận diện tiếng Việt thực tế của mô hình whisper.cpp (large-v3-turbo hoặc bản thu gọn) và khả năng tóm tắt tiếng Việt của các model Gemma 4/Qwen3 trong Yogurt đạt mức độ nào?
Có giải pháp đồng bộ dữ liệu cuộc họp giữa nhiều thiết bị hoặc lưu trữ tập trung về một máy chủ đám mây/VPS cá nhân hay không, hay chỉ lưu cục bộ tại máy cài đặt?

## FrigadeHQ/yogurt (https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt)
Description: Private AI meeting notes. Free and open source.
Homepage: https://yogurt.so
Language: TypeScript; license: MIT; created 2026-11-10; last push 2026-11-13
Latest release: v0.3.11 (2026-11-13)
README (start):
Private AI meeting notes. Free and open source.

  Download for Mac · Windows · Linux

  

  Yogurt records your calls without adding a bot to the meeting.

  macOS 14.4+ (Apple Silicon) · Windows 10 2004+ (x64) · Ubuntu 22.04+ or similar (x64 AppImage) · 8 GB memory
  yogurt.so · Help · Build and run locally · MIT license
  Made by Frigade.

## What it does

- **Live transcripts.** Yogurt records calls and turns speech into text as you talk.
- **Meeting summaries.** Yogurt writes up the conversation and any notes you add.
- **Private by default.** Your audio, transcripts and AI processing stay on your computer.
- **Free and open source.** You can use Yogurt without an account.
- **Who said what.** Yogurt names speakers from Zoom, Teams and Meet on Mac only.
- **Languages.** Multi-language mode transcribes 99 languages.
- **Recording reminders.** Yogurt offers to record when a supported call starts.
- **Answers with sources.** Yogurt answers questions across meetings and links to the source.
- **Folders and search.** You can find meetings by folder, title, notes or transcript.
- **Copy and export.** You can copy notes or transcripts, or save both as Markdown.
- **Local MCP server.** Your chosen assistant app can read your notes when you allow access.
- **Automatic stop.** Yogurt stops recording when the call ends.

## Watch the demo

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da16b894-beb1-491a-89e1-fd10666dc9b8

## How it works

1. **Record.** Start recording your microphone and call audio; you can add your own notes.
2. **Transcribe.** Yogurt uses whisper.cpp and, on supported Macs, Apple SpeechAnalyzer.
3. **Summarize and ask.** A local open-weight model runs through llama.cpp.

Meeting data stays local; Yogurt goes online for model downloads and update checks.

Where your meetings, recordings, settings and models are stored

- Mac uses `~/Library/Application Support/Yogurt`.
- Windows uses `%APPDATA%\Yogurt`.
- Linux uses `~/.config/Yogurt`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Yogurt` if set.

## FAQ

What kind of computer do I need?

> A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14.4 or newer, a 64-bit PC with Windows 10 (version 2004) or newer, or a 64-bit Linux computer with Ubuntu 22.04 or newer. Each needs at least 8 GB of memory. If your computer is too slow, Yogurt tells you during setup. Calendar and speaker names from calls are Mac only for now.

Windows says “Windows protected your PC.” What do I do?

> Click More info, then Run anyway. Windows shows this for new apps that aren’t signed with a Microsoft certificate yet. Yogurt is open source, so anyone can check what it does.

Does Yogurt join my meetings?

> No. Yogurt records your microphone and the sound playing on your computer. No bot joins the call, so let the other people on the call know you’re recording.

Are recordings saved?

> Yes. Your recordings, transcripts, and notes are saved locally on your computer.

Is Yogurt free?

> Yes. Yogurt is free and open source under the MIT license. No account is needed.

Does Yogurt work offline?

> Yes. After a one-time download of the AI models, transcription and summaries run locally on your computer.

How much does setup download?

> It depends on your computer. Yogurt downloads a smaller notes model first, about 5 GB, then the best one your computer can run well, which can be 14 GB or more. Recording works once setup finishes, and notes and questions work offline once the notes model is in.

How do I connect my assistant app?

> In **Settings → AI apps**, turn on access, copy the helper command, and add it as a local MCP server in your assistant app. Access is off by default. The app can read your meetings, notes and transcripts, but cannot change them. It may send what it reads to its own online model. Turn access off in Yogurt to stop further reads.

Can other apps read my notes through MCP?

> Access is off until you enable it in **Settings → AI apps**. Apps get read-only access to meetings, notes and transcripts. Mac and Linux use a socket in your profile folder with `0600` permissions, so only your user account can open it. Windows uses a named pipe with a new random name each launch, stored only in your profile folder. There is no per-app token, so any app running under your account can read while access is on. Settings shows connected apps by their self-reported names.

Which AI models does Yogurt use?

> Transcription uses Whisper through whisper.cpp, with large-v3-turbo or a smaller model depending on your computer. On supported Macs, Apple SpeechAnalyzer supplies live words while Whisper produces the saved transcript. Summaries and answers use a local open-weight model from the Gemma 4, gpt-oss or Qwen3 families, chosen for your hardware and run through llama.cpp. The app uses Electron and needs no account.

Which languages does Yogurt support?

> Pick **Multi-language** in **Settings → Language → Spoken language** to transcribe 99 languages. You can also switch from the **English** menu in a note’s footer before or during recording. English only is the default. Summaries follow the meeting’s main language; answers follow your question’s language. Settings also offers 32 app languages.

Which call apps does Yogurt work with?

> You can record calls in any app because Yogurt captures your microphone and system audio. Call detection covers Zoom, Teams and Meet. On Mac, Yogurt can also read their speaker names with Accessibility permission, when the call app shows who is speaking.

How does Yogurt know a call has started?

> It checks which apps are using your microphone. For browser calls, it also checks the tab title or a nearby calendar event with a call link. This triggers an offer to record; recording starts only when you choose to.

How do I connect my calendar?

> On Mac, allow Calendar access in Settings. Yogurt reads the calendars already on your computer and lets you choose which ones to show. You do not sign into a calendar account in Yogurt.

See [Build and run locally](docs/building.md) for setup, tests and installer builds.

## Introduction

Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that runs entirely on your local machine. It captures your meetings, transcribes them in real-time, and generates summaries with a local model by default. Audio and transcription never leave your device. If you choose a cloud AI provider for summaries, only the transcript text is sent to it. This makes it the perfect solution for professionals and enterprises who need to maintain complete control over their sensitive information.

## Why Meetily?

While there are many meeting transcription tools available, this solution stands out by offering:

- **Privacy First:** All processing happens locally on your device.
- **Cost-Effective:** Uses open-source AI models instead of expensive APIs.
- **Flexible:** Works offline and supports multiple meeting platforms.
- **Customizable:** Self-host and modify for your specific needs.

Note: Official builds are only on meetily.ai and github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily/releases.
    
The Privacy Problem

Meeting AI tools create significant privacy and compliance risks across all sectors:

- **$4.4M average cost per data breach** (IBM 2024)
- **€5.88 billion in GDPR fines** issued by 2025
- **400+ unlawful recording cases** filed in California this year

Whether you're a defense consultant, enterprise executive, legal professional, or healthcare provider, your sensitive discussions shouldn't live on servers you don't control. Cloud meeting tools promise convenience but deliver privacy nightmares with unclear data storage practices and potential unauthorized access.

**Meetily solves this:** Complete data sovereignty on your infrastructure, zero vendor lock-in, and full control over your sensitive conversations.

## Features

- **Local First:** All processing is done on your machine. No data ever leaves your computer.
- **Real-time Transcription:** Get a live transcript of your meeting as it happens.
- **AI-Powered Summaries:** Generate summaries of your meetings using powerful language models.
- **Multi-Platform:** Native apps for Windows and macOS (Apple Silicon). On Linux, build from source.
- **Open Source:** Meetily is open source and free to use.
- **Flexible AI Provider Support:** Choose from Ollama (local), Claude, Groq, OpenRouter, or use your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

## Installation

### 🪟 **Windows**

1. Download the latest `x64-setup.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily/releases/latest)
2. Run the installer

> **Windows compatibility:** The packaged installer uses a Vulkan-enabled Whisper build. It requires an AVX2-capable x64 CPU; AVX-512 is not required. CUDA acceleration requires a source build configured with a compatible NVIDIA CUDA toolchain.

### 🍎 **macOS**

1. Download `meetily_0.4.1_aarch64.dmg` from [Releases](https://github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily/releases/latest)
2. Open the downloaded `.dmg` file
3. Drag **Meetily** to your Applications folder
4. Open **Meetily** from Applications folder

### 🐧 **Linux**

Build from source following our detailed guides:

- [Building on Linux](docs/building_in_linux.md)
- [General Build Instructions](docs/BUILDING.md)

**Quick start:**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Zackriya-Solutions/meetily
cd meetily/frontend
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
./build-gpu.sh
```

## Key Features in Action

### 🎯 Local Transcription

Transcribe meetings entirely on your device using **Whisper** or **Parakeet** models. No cloud required.

    

### 📥 Import & Enhance `Beta`

Import existing audio files to generate transcripts, or enhance to re-transcribe any recorded meeting with a different model or language, all processed locally.

> Contributed by [Jeremi Joslin](https://github.com/jeremi), improved by [Vishnu P S](https://github.com/p-s-vishnu) and [Mohammed Safvan](https://github.com/mohammedsafvan)

    

### 🤖 AI-Powered Summaries

Generate meeting summaries with your choice of AI provider. **Ollama** (local) is recommended, with support for Claude, Groq, OpenRouter, and OpenAI.

    

    

### 🔒 Privacy-First Design

All data stays on your machine. Transcription models, recordings, and transcripts are stored locally.

    

### 🌐 Custom OpenAI Endpoint Support

Use your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint for AI summaries. Perfect for organizations with custom AI infrastructure or preferred providers.

    

### 🎙️ Professional Audio Mixing

Capture microphone and system audio simultaneously with intelligent ducking and clipping prevention.

    

### ⚡ GPU Acceleration

Acceleration depends on the platform and build you use:

- **macOS packages:** Metal and CoreML are enabled automatically.
- **Windows packages:** Whisper is built with Vulkan support.
- **Linux:** Build from source with the acceleration configuration appropriate for your system.

CUDA is available through an appropriately configured NVIDIA source build; the standard Windows installer does not select it automatically.

## System Architecture

Meetily is a single, self-contained application built with [Tauri](https://tauri.app/). It uses a Rust-based backend to handle all the core logic, and a Next.js frontend for the user interface.

For more details, see the [Architecture documentation](docs/architecture.md).

## For Developers

If you want to contribute to Meetily or build it from source, you'll need to have Rust and Node.js installed. For detailed build instructions, please see the [Building from Source guide](docs/BUILDING.md).

Pro FAQ
How long is the Pro trial?
The Pro trial is 14 days with full Pro features and flexible AI summaries (local or BYOK). No credit card required to start. After the trial you get a 1-day grace period, and your trial license is valid for activation within a 14-day window.
Do you offer a refund?
Yes. Pro includes a 30-day money-back guarantee. If Pro is not the right fit, email support within 30 days of purchase and we will refund you in full.
How much does Pro cost?
$10/user/month billed annually (60% off the $25/month regular price). 30-day money-back guarantee.
How are summaries generated and what data is sent?
Summaries are pluggable. Run a local model to keep everything on-device, or bring your own API key (Claude, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). With BYOK, only the transcript text is sent to your chosen provider. Audio and recordings never leave your device.
How does BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) work?
Bring your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You pay your provider directly, you control data retention and routing. See the per-provider privacy summaries at /llm-privacy for retention and zero-data-retention details.
Does Meetily send audio to the cloud for summaries?
No. Transcription runs locally by default, and on that path audio and recordings never leave your device. For summaries with BYOK, only the transcript text is sent to your chosen AI provider. If you prefer fully local, pair Meetily with Ollama.
Is Pro for individuals or teams?
Both. Pro is licensed per user at $10/user/month billed annually. You can buy a single seat for yourself or multiple seats for a team. For larger orgs with procurement or custom terms, talk to us about Enterprise.
Is Linux supported?
Pro ships native installers for Windows and macOS today. A native Linux build is in development - join the waitlist at /granola-for-linux. The Community Edition can be built from source on Linux today.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. You can cancel anytime from your billing portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current annual term, and you retain Pro access until then.
What's the difference between Pro and Community?
Community is free under MIT license with local transcription, AI summaries, audio import, and retranscription. Pro adds flexible AI summaries (local or BYOK), custom summary templates, advanced exports (PDF / DOCX / Markdown), connections to your AI assistant and your own scripts (MCP, webhooks, command-line tool), and email priority support.
What happens after the 14-day trial ends?
When your trial ends you can purchase Pro at $10/user/month billed annually, or fall back to Community Edition (free, MIT) with no data loss. Trial licenses are valid for activation within a 14-day window.
What payment methods do you accept?
Payments are processed via Lemon Squeezy. We accept all major credit and debit cards. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually.

Everything you need to know about Meetily pricing

What happens after my trial ends?
After 14 days, Pro features will be disabled but your data remains safe on your device. You can continue using Community features for free, or purchase a Pro license to restore full functionality. There's also a 1-day grace period after the trial ends.
Can I use Meetily completely free?
Yes! Meetily Community Edition is free and open source. Transcription runs on your device, and summaries run on a local model by default or through your own API key. Pro adds naming your speakers, cloud and custom transcription providers, and advanced exports.
How do I activate my license?
Open Meetily and follow the setup steps; at the license step, paste your license key and click Activate. It takes just seconds. Your trial key is shown on screen when you request it, and paid keys arrive by email after purchase. Trial keys must be activated within 14 days of generation.
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and Apple Pay through our secure payment partner LemonSqueezy. All transactions are encrypted and secure.
Can I get a refund?
Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with Meetily Pro, contact us at meetily@zackriya.com for a full refund, no questions asked.
Do I need an internet connection?
Meetily transcription runs locally on your device. You need internet for license activation, downloading the app, and downloading local AI models. Recordings and audio never leave your device. For summaries, you choose your provider: local AI or your own API key (BYOK).
What's the difference between Pro Trial and Pro?
Pro Trial gives you full access to all Pro features for 14 days at no cost. After the trial, you can purchase a Pro license ($120/year) to continue using Pro features. The only difference is the duration - trial is 14 days, paid is 1 year.
Can I use the same license on multiple devices?
Each Pro license is valid for one device. If you need licenses for multiple devices or team members, contact us about Enterprise plans which offer volume licensing with discounts.
